description: The 8 March Quito event has a clear local qualitative estimate of hundreds; Guayaquil and Cuenca are separate local actions without site-level counts. Do not pool across cities.
required_followup: Find city-specific counts or clear simultaneous crowd descriptions for Guayaquil and Cuenca.

description: Guayaquil’s march rejected femicides and Cuenca’s completed march/memorial commemorated victims, but the local body does not establish a specific demand on the State for those local actions.
required_followup: Seek local organizer/source reporting that identifies a State authority or policy target and exact demand for each city.

description: The March 1 Guayaquil Front Popular plantón and Quito FEUE plantons are reported as occurring, but no site-specific attendance count is given.
required_followup: Find local reporting with a simultaneous attendance estimate at each location; do not combine the two cities.

description: El Comercio reports FEUE joined Quito plantons on 1 March but does not establish the demand at those actual gatherings. A 28 February announcement is not proof of the March 1 agenda.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous source on the March 1 Quito action’s specific State target and demand.

description: Primicias describes Cuenca’s 17:00 gathering outside Gobernación as planned at 16:43 update time; occurrence and demand remain unverified.
required_followup: Find later same-day or following-day confirmation before coding the scheduled gathering as completed.

description: Ecuavisa search result returned relevant 8 March claims, but an exact-URL open returned a tool-level Internal Error without an HTTP status. The body was not available and the attempt was not repeated.
required_followup: Use independent accessible sources already captured or a newly assessed distinct publisher; do not retry this URL after a technical failure unless a policy-supported ordinary HTTPS recovery is authorized.

description: Actual Quito actions on 14 March (FUT), 25 March (UNE) and 28 March (CONAIE) are now documented. No evidence yet establishes whether any episode continued into April; announced actions alone do not prove continuity.
required_followup: Check April coverage for a demonstrated continuation and document any event end time; do not carry planned actions into completed-event coding.

description: Research so far emphasizes national/march announcements, Quito, Guayaquil and Cuenca. March activity in other provinces and sectors beyond women’s rights, Indigenous actions, FEUE, Frente Popular and labor announcements is not exhaustively covered.
required_followup: Search provincial outlets and sector terms for transport, education, health, agriculture, extractive industries, public services and local government through the rest of March.

description: The FUT march on 14 March is directly reported in Quito with state-policy demands, but no participant count or qualitative size estimate is provided.
required_followup: Find local reporting with a site-specific estimate of simultaneous attendance; do not infer from union membership or the presence of several legislators.

description: A CONAIE-led march reached the National Assembly on 28 March and delivered/advanced a water-law proposal, but the report gives no crowd estimate.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous site-specific coverage for a local simultaneous attendance estimate and verify receipt/response without inferring crowd size from the organizers.

description: A search-result snippet claims 25 March pro-life marches in several cities and a multi-city “thousands” total, but the exact article body was not retrieved and no local count or specific State target is established.
required_followup: Use an independently accessible source or organizer report after exact-URL/source-origin assessment to verify each local gathering, State demand and site-level simultaneous count; do not retry the failed ACI URL or aggregate locations.

description: Expreso’s search-only snippet lists a 28 March plantón at Cuenca’s Gobernación de Azuay and a Guayaquil plantón outside Gobernación del Guayas, with an approximate “about a dozen” description for Guayaquil. The exact body could not be retrieved. Neither local lead is excluded or confirmed on this snippet alone; no city counts are pooled.
required_followup: Seek independent accessible local reporting for both sites and verify each gathering, exact attendance and demand. The exact Expreso URL already returned a technical Internal Error without HTTP status; do not retry it or use a URL variant. Do not infer exclusion or qualification solely from the snippet.

description: The March 17 CONAIE internal assembly announced future sit-ins at the Constitutional Court and Assembly, but no completed public sit-in is verified in the sources consulted. The body explicitly described that leadership meeting as restricted and not mass.
required_followup: Seek independent contemporaneous evidence of any actually completed public sit-in and its local crowd size; the internal assembly itself is excluded and future plans are not coded as completed events.
